input.quote: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
input.rationale: Section 6.1 imposes an exclusive-dealing restraint on the Company (our client): for the whole term it may not participate in any similar internet project for Deerskin Products or loosely defined "substantially similar" products, and HDI gets the exclusive right to the "Deerskin" brand web site. Under Section 4.1 the term renews automatically each year, so the restraint is effectively open-ended, and there is no performance-based exit (Section 1.6 only allows termination if the Site is not live within 70 days of signature). That matches the playbook walk-away pattern of exclusive dealing for the full term without a performance exit. Because HDI gives reciprocal exclusivity in Section 6.3 and Section 6.2 preserves a closeout carve-out, full deletion is disproportionate; we take the fallback by limiting the restraint to Deerskin Products for 12 months from the Effective Date with automatic termination on HDI's failure to meet the launch date or its service/delivery obligations. HDI's own exclusivity covenants and the exclusivity benefiting the Company are left untouched.

proposal.summary: Narrow Section 6.1 exclusivity on the Company to Deerskin Products for 12 months, with automatic termination on HDI performance failure.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that we do not accept exclusivity obligations on the Company; as a compromise we have limited Section 6.1 to Deerskin Products for twelve (12) months and made it fall away automatically if HDI misses the launch date in Section 1.6 or its other service or delivery commitments. As drafted the restraint ran for the full (annually renewing) term, covered loosely defined "substantially similar" products, and gave us no performance-based exit.

ops.newText: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the period of twelve (12) months following the Effective Date, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products, and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet. The restrictions on the Company set forth in this Section 6.1 shall terminate automatically, without notice, penalty or further liability, upon HDI's failure to have the Site fully operational within the period specified in Section 1.6 or upon any other failure by HDI to meet the service levels, delivery dates or other performance obligations set forth in this Agreement.
